title: THE FRONTIER WEEK · The gambler
venue: the Newport paper · a western week the editor cut · Box 3
logline: A riverboat gambler off a boat that has no river to have come up, at the saloon's one table, dealing cards to nobody and smoothing his lapels between hands. He offers the stranger a card. The stranger takes it face down and puts it in his hat. The gambler asks his name. Small Wood.
